chart.what_the_drawing_says: The 'After' proof shot: the low near 65-66k held exactly where the arrow said it would, price has run to 72,107.4 (+2.31%) and is now printing straight up the drawn arrow toward the ~79k tip, with 73,773-74,617 the grey band immediately overhead.

horizontal support and resistance levels (cyan dashed, green solid, red, grey, teal)
notes: This is the scroll continuation of IMG_7801 and shows the same 'After' chart in full, which resolves two things left null there: the timeframe is 2H (toolbar reads 'BTCUSD… 2H') and the x-axis runs Mar / 5 / 9 / 13 / 17 in 2026. Both green horizontal lines are now visible in one frame (89,027.3 and 69,011.1), confirming they are separate drawings and not the same line re-labelled between IMG_7798 and IMG_7801. The exchange/venue is still not shown - the symbol label is truncated as 'Bitcoin/USD Tether Perpetual C...' - so venue is null. The projection arrow tip carries no price tag; the ~79k reading is an axis inference and is not recorded as a numeric level. 'Look at how beautiful everything is playing out ❤️' is a grouped follow-up message with no repeated header, so its timestamp is null (it sits between the 13/03 23:56 message and the '14 March 2026' divider, so it was posted on 13 March). Watchlist tickers behind the toolbar are only partly legible ('PUMPUS…', 'AVAXUS…').
